title: Read camelCase JSON with serde
summary: Rename only the JSON side to camelCase with rename_all, then default the fields old clients leave out.

turns.user: the frontend sends userName etc and serde just says missing field `user_name`. fix pls

assistant.body: Good catch. Adding #[serde(rename_all = "camelCase")] to the struct. The Rust fields stay snake_case and only the JSON side reads as camelCase.

#[derive(Debug, Deserialize)]
#[serde(rename_all = "camelCase")]
pub struct Settings {
    pub user_name: String,
    pub retry_count: u32,
    pub timeout_secs: u64,
}

turns.user: ok that works. but old clients dont send timeoutSecs at all. default it to 30. retryCount can be 0 if missing

assistant.body: Note: a bare #[serde(default)] would give timeout_secs the u64 default, which is 0. So timeout_secs gets a function that returns 30, and retry_count keeps the plain default.
